propositions: The region_source provenance label is currently mislabeled as REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION even when the region value comes from rebar.toml config file, because _llm_str discards the value's origin during CLI/env/config-file resolution

Resolution of bedrock_region_name must preserve and carry the true source (repo-config, cli, REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION, AWS_DEFAULT_REGION, or AWS_REGION) from the same single resolution pass that determined the winning value, without changing precedence (CLI > env > file > default)
The resolved region source must be threaded as bedrock_region_source through LLMConfig to resolve_bedrock_region and provenance_for so the label is derived once and never re-derived independently
Region values resolved from config file, CLI, and AWS env vars must be labeled with the truthful source in provider provenance records while maintaining byte-identical region VALUES and build paths
No CI-provider-specific code or environment hooks are permitted; the solution must be pure in-process labeling working in any environment
